business_goals.name: Defend NIM through better risk-adjusted pricing
business_goals.strategic_context: NIM compression accelerating (14bp/quarter, 3 consecutive quarters). Need to price better, not chase volume.

business_goals.name: Achieve regulatory posture for AI
business_goals.strategic_context: SR 11-7 + FFIEC AI guidance + OCC bulletins tightening. Must demonstrate model risk maturity to examiners.

business_goals.name: Reduce loss + protect customer experience
business_goals.strategic_context: Fraud rising in digital channels. False positives damaging customer experience.

business_goals.name: Productivity uplift in middle/back office
business_goals.strategic_context: Cost-to-income ratio above peer median. Need productivity gains.

initiatives.name: M365 Copilot for Knowledge Workers
initiatives.description: M365 Copilot deployed selectively. Finance and Legal driving adoption; IT and Operations underwhelming. Q3 2026 expansion decision gated on per-function ROI study.

initiatives.name: AI-Assisted Code Review for Risk Engineering
initiatives.description: Cursor + custom rules for risk engineering team. Initially scoped narrowly because of model risk governance concerns. Expansion to broader engineering pending CISO sign-off.

initiatives.name: Advisor Decision-Support AI
initiatives.description: AI overlay for branch advisors. Pulls relevant client context, suggests products, drafts follow-up communications. Productivity gains real but expansion paused waiting on the model governance operating model decision.
initiatives.status_summary: Productivity +14% in pilot · expansion paused pending governance

initiatives.name: Credit Decisioning Modernization
initiatives.description: Modernization of consumer credit decisioning models from legacy logistic regression to gradient-boosted + alternative-data ensemble. Single biggest AI investment in the portfolio. Tied directly to NIM compression mitigation thesis.
initiatives.status_summary: Foundation phase · model build underway · Y2 deployment target
initiatives.aligned_rationale: Single largest AI investment in the portfolio. Directly tied to NIM compression mitigation. The most-cited Move candidate in Sentinel's exploration threads.

initiatives.name: Fraud Detection AI Refresh
initiatives.description: Fraud detection model refresh with newer architecture. Currently in P1 Charter as a Strategic Move (M-FCF-009). Platform-grade investment with defined business case.
initiatives.status_summary: In flight as Strategic Move · pre-mortem candidate

initiatives.name: Conversational Banking Assistant
initiatives.description: AI conversational interface in digital banking app. Account inquiries, transaction lookups, basic servicing. Pilot scaling slowly; containment below target attributed to limited use-case coverage.

initiatives.name: Model Risk Governance Operating Model
initiatives.description: Operating model for who owns model risk across the bank. Currently contested between CDO and CIO. Until resolved, model deployment cadence is blocked. Regulatory bar from SR 11-7 makes this urgent rather than optional.
initiatives.status_summary: CDO–CIO conflict unresolved 3 quarters · CEO declined arbitration twice
initiatives.aligned_rationale: Blocker for 4 other AI initiatives. SR 11-7 regulatory urgency rising. The single most-impactful unblock available — resolving this unblocks Credit Decisioning, Fraud Refresh, Advisor AI expansion, and Conversational Banking.

stakeholder_notes.quote: I'm concerned about being named on three concurrent programs simultaneously with no capacity relief.
Until model risk has a single owner, we're going to keep relitigating the same fights.
Model risk should sit with whoever runs the model in production. That's IT.
We're sitting on a working pilot with measurable productivity gains and we can't expand because of governance. That's a bad signal to the org.

decisions.dissent_summary: CDO and CIO both want ownership · CEO has declined to arbitrate

vendors.notes: Younger vendor; financial health bears watching
Renewal underway · scope refresh in progress

scenarios.scenario_name: Examiner finding on AI model governance
scenarios.impact_summary: MRA likely · forces accelerated governance build · disrupts existing model deployments
Y2 deployment pushed to Q3 2027 · NIM compression mitigation thesis weakens

scenarios.scenario_name: Pilot wound down due to governance stall
scenarios.impact_summary: $1.1M reallocated · advisor productivity work paused · org signal that AI expansion is hard at FCF
